## Requirements: Scope CI workflow triggers to relevant changes

GitHub Actions CI currently starts broad build/test workflows on **every PR**, regardless of changed files. A workflow-only PR unnecessarily builds Rust/Web and runs full browser E2E, even though no application/runtime behavior, test suite, or test environment changed.

**Verified reproduction — PR #2087 (2026-10-20):**
- Diff: exactly **one added line** in `.github/workflows/agent-controller-dispatch.yml` (allow exact owner-only `/nession resume issue=1997 checkpoint=2` command).
- [CI / Quality Gate run 39444999181](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/39444999181): both `rust-check` and `web-check` executed.
- [E2E / Tests run 39444999306](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/39444999306): full Web/Rust build and Playwright E2E executed. Job log: `E2E selection mode: full, selected:`.
- [Acceptance / Case Smoke run 39444999270](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/39444999270): Web/Rust build, Chromium installation, and two generic representative Cases executed.
- The above three workflow definitions (`ci-quality.yml`, `e2e-tests.yml`, `acceptance-case-smoke.yml`) have unrestricted `pull_request` triggers for `main`/`staging`. E2E's Issue selector also falls back to `mode: full` for linked Issues without `## E2E Verification`; #1664/#2010 lack that section. That fallback should not force unrelated *application* E2E for a workflow-only change.

This is a **workflow trigger and test applicability issue**, not a defect in the one-line #2087 command predicate.

**Desired behavior:** Only schedule a CI/test workflow when the PR's changes can affect what it validates. A PR changing only the trusted Controller dispatch YAML must not start Rust/Web Quality, full Playwright E2E, or generic Acceptance Case Smoke. It **must** still get appropriate YAML and Controller authorization/negative-contract validation.

**Constraints:** Avoid a new generic CI router, workflow engine, database, dispatch protocol, or blanket all-PR test requirement. Prefer native GitHub Actions event/path filters; use a minimal job-level condition only where stable required check contexts make workflow-level filtering unsafe.

**Implementation scope:**

1. **Audit** all active `.github/workflows/*.yml` event triggers: `pull_request`, `push`, `workflow_run`, `issue_comment`, `schedule`, `workflow_dispatch`, etc. Record which change/event actually makes each workflow useful, its required-check status, and any current verified downstream dependency. Avoid `workflow_run` fan-out for unrelated completions.
2. **Scope PR Quality** so Rust checks run on Rust/workspace/dependency/Gate inputs; Web checks run on Web/dependency/design/Gate inputs. Changing only an unrelated workflow should not invoke either full suite. Account for shared tooling/config changes that legitimately impact both.
3. **Scope PR E2E** to application behavior, E2E specs/runner, runtime setup, or other actual E2E inputs. A mere Issue link, workflow-only change, or missing `## E2E Verification` section must not result in full E2E when the change has no E2E impact. Preserve fail-closed full/selected fallback for **relevant** changed code whose obligations are not proven.
4. **Scope PR Acceptance Case Smoke** to source-aligned Case/contract, acceptance runner, and affected runtime changes. Do not run generic representative Cases for a Controller YAML-only PR. Cover the canonical `e2e/acceptance/**` tree (see #1538).
5. **Keep lightweight validation** for workflow-only PRs: YAML/actionlint, applicable permissions/trigger/Controller self-tests and negative cases; explicitly test exact owner/main, approved comment, and rejected variants for changes like #2087. Do not treat skipped E2E as E2E Pass.
6. **Do not break required checks or security boundaries.** Before adding `paths`, identify branch rules / required check contexts. A skipped required workflow can stay Pending. If a check must remain present, keep a lightweight stable check context with expensive jobs conditionally omitted; no PR-head code may make privileged routing decisions or receive main-only secrets.
7. **Preserve legitimate main-push, exact-SHA, post-merge and deployment evidence.** Audit all consumers before changing post-merge `push` triggers; do not delete mandatory #1690/#1702/#1876 proof just to save CPU. If a post-merge check genuinely needs to run for every merged SHA, document that explicit exception; otherwise remove unrelated runs without manufacturing Pass evidence.
8. **No redundant work for the same SHA/scope.** Where workflows overlap, avoid duplicate full builds/browser suites and retain one canonical evidence producer; do not conflate a missing/inapplicable check with successful test execution.

### Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01 Produce a repository-wide workflow trigger audit (trigger, path/scope, reason, required check, downstream evidence consumer), identifying unrelated/duplicate run creation and documented exceptions.
- [x] SC-02 PR touching **only** `.github/workflows/agent-controller-dispatch.yml` does **not** create a Rust Quality, Web Quality, full E2E, or generic Acceptance Case Smoke heavy run; it executes YAML + targeted Controller/security contract validation.
- [x] SC-03 Rust-only PR runs relevant Rust checks; Web-only PR runs relevant Web checks; relevant E2E/Case changes still trigger their required suites. Test with representative changed-path fixtures, including shared build/Gate inputs.
- [x] SC-04 E2E planner no longer expands workflow-only/irrelevant diffs to `full` because a referenced Issue lacks E2E metadata; relevant unknown-impact changes continue to fail closed rather than silently skip.
- [x] SC-05 Canonical Acceptance Case path changes under `e2e/acceptance/**` are not missed, and unrelated workflow-only changes do not cause a full Case Smoke.
- [x] SC-06 Required GitHub checks remain mergeable (no perpetually Pending filtered check) and present truthful applicability/no-op metadata; no inapplicable run is represented as proven E2E or Acceptance Pass.
- [ ] SC-07 Existing required post-merge exact-SHA Quality/E2E/Acceptance evidence and authenticated Store ingestion continue to work, or a verified equivalent evidence contract is established before removing any trigger.
- [x] SC-08 Verify on real exact-head PRs or controlled workflow probes that the #2087-like case avoids unnecessary Runner minutes while relevant code changes still execute the expected gates; link run IDs/logs and document before/after run count.

## Boundaries and references

- Trigger routing is the scope here; **#2031** separately owns event-driven Acceptance coordination, elimination of empty receiver runs and cron polling. Reuse its trigger audit findings; don't build a competing orchestration architecture.
- **#1876** owns browser/design duplication and Web artifact reuse *inside valid E2E runs*; this Issue owns whether those runs should start at all.
- Preserve `.github/AGENTS.md` workflow-change delivery policy: isolated main-based PR directly to `main`, merge commit, trusted workflow/security boundary.
- Prefer minimal direct YAML changes and focused regression proof rather than a new multiphase framework.
